game.title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-09-17 on the home PC (3440x1440 desktop): version 1.19 build 801.0. Steam launch -> the launcher inside the exe -> Play -> main menu, windowed 1280x720 via the registry, quit with WM_CLOSE + Yes. 2026-10-15 on the dev PC (1920x1080): -nolauncher straight to the menu, windowed 1280x720 by the registry, STORY -> CONTINUE -> Space into gameplay, quit with WM_CLOSE + Enter.

input.api: keyboard by scancode (SendInput, game window in front): arrows with the extended flag, Enter, Space, Escape drive every menu [verified-live 2026-10-15, n=2 runs]; mouse clicks for the launcher; the quit dialog answers Enter = Yes [verified-live 2026-10-15, n=2]

states.name: launcher
states.detect: A launcher window inside the exe, 790x445, window class NxApp: 'Play Deus Ex: Mankind Divided', Options, Website..., Quit.

states.name: main_menu
states.detect: STORY / BREACH / JENSEN'S STORIES / EXTRAS / OPTIONS / SHOP / SQUARE ENIX / QUIT.

states.name: quit_confirm
states.detect: In-game 'Quit game?' with Yes / No, raised by WM_CLOSE.

states.name: story_card
states.detect: After loading: a story card with 'Continue [SPACE]' at the bottom right; Space enters gameplay.

states.name: gameplay
states.detect: HUD: portrait call box top left, minimap top right, ammo box bottom right.

steps: wait for the launcher window (class NxApp)
click Play at about (345*1.79, 40*1.79) px from the launcher's top-left (1.79 = the display scale on the home PC)
wait until the main menu is fully drawn (screenshot), then Enter on STORY
routes.notes: Two Enter presses sent right after the window appeared were lost; check the screen before each press.

steps: PostMessage WM_CLOSE to the game window
VERIFY the process has exited before the next step
routes.notes: A WM_CLOSE alone leaves the game running (see hazards).

config_files: Registry HKCU\Software\Eidos Montreal\Deus Ex: MD\Graphics (DWORDs): Fullscreen=0, WindowWidth=1280, UserWindowWidth=1280, WindowHeight=720, UserWindowHeight=720 gave a 1296x759 window [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1]. A .reg backup was exported first.

Registry same key: Fullscreen=1, ExclusiveFullscreen=1, Stereoscopic3DMode=1 = side-by-side 3D, two squeezed eye pictures with real per-eye parallax [verified-live 2026-10-15, n=1]. Ran at 1920x1080 despite FullscreenWidth/Height 1280x720; started minimised; mouse clicks miss in this mode, keyboard works. Put back to 0 after.
entry_points.logs: Documents\Deus Ex -  Mankind Divided\Deus Ex -  Mankind Divided.log (note the double space)
entry_points.proxy_dll: dxgi.dll beside DXMD.exe: hit the AcGenral early call, then CreateDXGIFactory2, CompatValue, CreateDXGIFactory [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1].

hazards.hazard: WM_CLOSE asks 'Quit game?' instead of exiting
hazards.notes: A WM_CLOSE sent while the next step assumed the game was gone left it running. Click Yes, then verify the process has exited.

hazards.hazard: The dxgi proxy is called before its DllMain runs
hazards.notes: Windows' AcGenral compatibility shim calls dxgi SetAppCompatStringPointer before the proxy's DllMain has loaded the real dxgi.dll (found in x64dbg). A proxy must resolve the real function on that early call instead of jumping through an empty table.
The launcher's layout is scaled 1.79x on the home PC; scale click offsets by the window's display scale on other machines.

hazards.hazard: Side-by-side 3D starts minimised and ignores mouse clicks in menus
hazards.notes: Bring the window to the front; use the keyboard (Enter answers the quit dialog with Yes).
